name: Navbar
description: The top bar: a brand, primary links or a search, and account actions, as a full-width bar or an island. Glass is a surface. Replaces Livewire's nav.

livewire.name: navbar
capabilities: Children: navbar-item links in the default slot; links renders the same children

react.name: Navbar
capabilities: Children: NavbarItem links; links renders the same children

vue.name: Navbar
capabilities: Children: NavbarItem links in the default slot; links renders the same children

props.name: layout
props.description: A full-width bar with an edge below it (marketing pages), or a rounded island (inside AppShell). Emitted as data-layout.

props.name: surface
props.description: The surface. Emitted as data-surface. Glass falls back to the raised surface under reduced transparency and without backdrop-filter, and is opaque in high contrast.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Sticks to the top of the scrolling container. Emitted as data-sticky.

props.name: brand
props.description: The brand at the start: a logo or mark and the product name, usually a link home.

props.name: links
props.description: The primary links as data, rendering the same children as composition: { label, href, current }.

props.name: search
props.description: A search field between the links and the actions; it takes the free space.

props.name: actions
props.description: Controls at the end: sign in, notifications, the account menu.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the links' nav landmark. Livewire translates the default with __().
props.a11y: Change it when the page has another nav named Main.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { links: '…', actions: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The bar, carrying the root class. A header landmark (banner) when it's the page's top bar.

parts.name: links
parts.description: The nav landmark holding the links. Scrolls along the inline axis when the bar is too narrow for them.

parts.name: link
parts.description: A primary link, aria-current=page on the current one.

parts.name: search
parts.description: Holds the search field and takes the free space.

keyboard.action: Move through the brand link, the links, the search and the actions in order.

requirements: A header element; the links sit in a nav landmark named with label.
The current page's link sets aria-current=page and is shown by surface, not color alone.
An icon-only action is named with aria-label, and a notification indicator is in that name too (Notifications, 3 unread).
Keep to about six links; on a narrow bar they scroll rather than wrap or hide, so every link stays reachable.
Glass keeps text at 4.5:1 over any backdrop, falls back to an opaque surface under reduced transparency and in high contrast.
Links show the focus ring on :focus-visible.
